title.zh: 将阿帕约省 Conner 市镇 Conner 国立中学（Ripang 附属中学）从该校分离并改设为名为 Conner 中央国立中学的独立国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Conner National High School - (Ripang Annex High School) in the Municipality of Conner, Province of Apayao, From the Conner National High School in the Municipality of Conner, and Converting It Into a Separate and Independent National High School to Be Known as the Conner Central National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Conner National High School - (Ripang Annex High School) in the Municipality of Conner, Province of Apayao, From the Conner National High School in the Municipality of Conner, and Converting It Into a Separate and Independent National High School to Be Known as the Conner Central National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8414_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Conner National High School - (Ripang Annex High School) in the Municipality of Conner, Province of Apayao, is hereby separated from the Conner National High School in the Municipality of Conner, and converted into a separate and independent national high school to be known as Conner Central National High School.

The school shall offer secondary education proper, as well as secondary science courses to carry out its objectives, and as may be authorized by the Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Conner National High School - (Ripang Annex High School) are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Conner Central National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
